title: Thai-Style Stir Fry with Morcilla
description: A spicy and savory stir fry dish featuring crispy morcilla and a variety of vegetables, inspired by the flavors of Thailand.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it starts to caramelize.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the morcilla and cook until it's browned on all sides and crispy.
Add the fish sauce, brown sugar, and chili flakes. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the stir fry to a serving platter and garnish with chopped cilantro.
